title: satureja dentata
intro: Satureja dentata, commonly known as Yemen tea or dentate savory, is a flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. It is a shrub-like perennial with small flowers and is traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Satureja dentata include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to alleviate digestive issues and reduce the severity of colds and flu. The bioactive constituents of this plant include carvacrol, thymol, and rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
